title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Period Of Warmth〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh... I didn't realize you were still doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, maybe we ought to start looking for schools for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Based on your academic level, you should be able to get into anywhere you like, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I was just a little worried, since it's already two in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be awake for a little while longer, so please let me know if you'd like a midnight snack.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh...
You didn't score as well as you did last time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's just trying to look out for me, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Kanade's probable working offline.
Mizuki's also probably working or watching TV.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And Ena probably isn't home yet at this hour...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because I sort of understand what it means to feel anxious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If there's anything you want to ask me about, that's totally fine... And I'll also do my best to come up with good topics on my own.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena and Mizuki will also probably jump onto Nightcord if you ask them. Plus, you can always go to see Miku and the others in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, please don't hesitate to ask.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Will someone log in if I ask them to in chat...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, I still need to do my homework...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This bracelet... It's the one Mizuki gave me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, right. I left it in my bag...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike Kanade, we can't be there when you talk to her, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I thought these would help make it feel like we're there with you in spirit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Despite being handmade, it's very well put-together.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This makes it hard to write in my notebook...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I'll keep it in my pocket whenever I'm at home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to finish my homework before we get started later...
